derivation: by simpa [shift, Set.image] using (Set.image_singleton (f := fun m : ℕ => m + 1) (a := n))
explanation: `shift X` is the set image of `X` under `m ↦ m + 1`, up to the orientation of the equality in its set-comprehension definition. `Set.image_singleton` therefore yields the result for `{n}`. The existing proof instead proves it by extensionality and simplification.
